title: Module 2: authority, tools and runtime truth

checks.title: B1 read-side tools: numbered reads and their decoder (R-24), limits and refusals, containment on the read side (R-30)
B1 tool-slot policy: six essentials within eight slots, optional order, lower caps, excluded essentials refuse
B2 per-invocation shell approval through the dispatch boundary: repository content grants nothing, trust changes nothing, every invocation asks with its exact bytes, legacy grants never run

B4 warnings that know about egress: the sixteen-command bypass list and the script example earn their categories, every warning reaches the prompt as "looks like", and each still asks with Run Once or Deny
B5 bounded, killable command execution: fifty megabytes of output stay bounded at the process boundary and in the window; a timeout, a cancel, a dispose and a closing window each kill the command
B5 runner seam: darwin and linux take the POSIX path and run, win32 refuses and starts nothing
B5 runner seam: no Onyx product file outside the seam names a shell path or a signal, or starts a process itself

B12 honest stream termination and index freshness: each ending is reported as what it was, a silent request is stopped at its deadline, a cut-off reply is never applied or called complete, and a persisted index is reconciled with the tree or rebuilt
B12 argument validation: a call whose arguments do not match the tool's schema is answered and never dispatched

B11 diagnostics that redact what they say they redact: a journal, settings and logs seeded with a sentinel in every content channel produce a default bundle, and a zip, with none of them; the API key is absent even with content included
B3 tool capability contract at the service layer: the wire carries only contracted tools by default and with the network opt-in (R-05); a stored note needs a confirmation that shows its origin (R-59)
B3 upstream's Agent Host is excluded: the switch is off and no agent-host session type can start a chat (the packaged smoke and the end-to-end suite check that it never starts)
Every defect fixed in this module has a resurrection mutant that its script and the seeded campaign detect
